grammar.q: Recycling paper and plastic at school, along with reducing food waste, [ ____ ] students understand their impact on the environment.
Both the size of a city’s population and the quality of its public transportation [ ____ ] how much time residents spend commuting and how they use their weekends.
Either the students in the drama club or their teacher [ ____ ] going to present the award.
Seventy percent of the annual precipitation in this region [ ____ ] during the three summer months, causing frequent floods.
The wounded from the earthquake [ ____ ] transported by helicopter to hospitals in nearby cities.
Rarely [ ____ ] the members of the committee agree on a decision without arguing for several hours first.
The quality (of the essays) (submitted by students who attended the writing workshop) [ ____ ] noticeably higher than last year’s.
The solar panels (installed on the roof of the community center that opened last spring) [ ____ ] to be cleaned regularly.
How quickly a species adapts to changes in its environment [ ____ ] often determined by the length of its life cycle.
Asking students to explain concepts in their own words instead of memorizing definitions [ ____ ] a proven teaching method.
Beneath the surface of the frozen lake, there [ ____ ] countless tiny organisms that survive the long, dark winter.
Few teenagers in the survey read for pleasure these days, nor [ ____ ] their parents, who mostly spend their free time online.
The key to reducing traffic accidents [ ____ ] not more roads but better education for drivers.
Volunteers who [ ____ ] their weekends cleaning beaches often say that the experience changed their views on plastic consumption.
About half of the food produced in the world [ ____ ] wasted before it reaches consumers.
Among the benefits of learning a second language early [ ____ ] a greater ability to focus on difficult tasks.
What the researchers found after analyzing medical data from thousands of patients [ ____ ] surprising to doctors.
A number of local businesses that depend on tourism [ ____ ] struggled since the new highway bypassed the town.
The reasons that the committee gave for rejecting the proposal to build a new stadium near the river [ ____ ] not convincing to the residents who had supported it.
Equally important as the amount of sleep [ ____ ] the regularity of the times at which we go to bed and wake up.
The list of safety precautions that every visitor to the chemical laboratory must follow [ ____ ] displayed near the entrance.
The photographs that the journalist took in the migrant camps [ ____ ] now on display in Seoul.
Every student and teacher at the school [ ____ ] asked to complete a questionnaire about the new policy on mobile phones.
Reading novels written by authors from different cultures [ ____ ] teenagers develop empathy for people whose lives differ from theirs.
What most residents of large cities want from their local government [ ____ ] a cleaner and safer environment.
The number of people who cycle to work in European cities [ ____ ] doubled over the past decade.
A number of rare plants that once grew along the river [ ____ ] disappeared because of pollutants from nearby factories.
Most of the equipment in the hospital’s emergency room [ ____ ] donated by a foundation.
Some of the vegetables grown in the school garden [ ____ ] served at the cafeteria during the harvest festival.
There [ ____ ] a growing body of evidence that regular physical activity improves both memory and reasoning in older adults.
Neither the director nor the actors who had rehearsed for months [ ____ ] prepared for the cold reaction.
Not only the students but also their teacher [ ____ ] surprised to learn that the experiment had produced the opposite result.
The engineer who designed the bridges connecting the islands to the mainland [ ____ ] received an award from the government for his imaginative use of recycled materials.
Those who [ ____ ] to apply for the exchange program must submit a recommendation letter by Friday.
My brother is one of the few students in his school who [ ____ ] won a national prize in both math and science.
The only one of the candidates who [ ____ ] able to answer every question during the interview was offered the job immediately.
Three hours [ ____ ] too long for young children to sit still in a classroom without a break.
Each of the athletes competing in next month’s marathon [ ____ ] to pass a strict medical examination beforehand.
Ten kilometers [ ____ ] a reasonable distance for novice runners to complete in their first race if they train regularly for two months.
The elderly in rural villages, where public transportation is limited, [ ____ ] on their neighbors for rides to the hospital.
The mayor, along with several council members, [ ____ ] criticized for ignoring the opinions of local residents.
In the center of the square [ ____ ] a bronze statue of the scientist who discovered the cure for the disease.
Hidden among the thousands of books in the old library [ ____ ] several letters written by the town’s founder.
Each of the volunteers who signed up for the beach cleanup organized by local high schools [ ____ ] going to receive a certificate at the ceremony tonight.

arrange.ko: 지난 10년 동안 대중교통을 이용해 출근하는 직장인의 수가 꾸준히 늘었다.
arrange.bogi: has increased steadily over the past ten years / who take public transportation to work / the number of / office workers
arrange.ans: The number of office workers who take public transportation to work has increased steadily over the past ten years.

arrange.ko: 어린 시절에 다른 사람의 감정을 이해하는 능력을 기르는 것은 학교에서 좋은 성적을 받는 것만큼 중요하다.
arrange.bogi: as important as getting good grades at school / developing the ability / is / to understand others’ feelings in childhood
arrange.ans: Developing the ability to understand others’ feelings in childhood is as important as getting good grades at school.

arrange.ko: 그 박람회에 참가하는 학생들은 각자 자신의 발명품이 실생활의 문제를 어떻게 해결하는지 설명해야 한다.
arrange.bogi: has to explain / each of the students / how their invention solves a real-life problem / taking part in the fair
arrange.ans: Each of the students taking part in the fair has to explain how their invention solves a real-life problem.

arrange.ko: 우리가 새로운 기술을 더 자주 연습할수록, 그것은 스트레스를 받는 상황에서 더 자연스럽게 나온다.
arrange.bogi: the more naturally / we practice a new skill / it comes to us in stressful situations / the more often
arrange.ans: The more often we practice a new skill, the more naturally it comes to us in stressful situations.

arrange.ko: 이 박물관을 특별하게 만드는 것은 그것이 방문객들에게 소장품을 보여 주는 방식이다.
arrange.bogi: is how it displays / what makes / its collection to visitors / this museum special
arrange.ans: What makes this museum special is how it displays its collection to visitors.

arrange.ko: 올해 우리 학교 졸업생의 수는 작년의 졸업생 수보다 더 많다.
arrange.bogi: is larger than / the number of graduates / that of last year / from our school this year
arrange.ans: The number of graduates from our school this year is larger than that of last year.

arrange.ko: 휴대 전화로 모든 것을 확인하는 데 익숙한 십대들은 종이 지도를 읽는 데 어려움을 겪는다.
arrange.bogi: have difficulty reading paper maps / teenagers who / are used to / checking everything on their phones
arrange.ans: Teenagers who are used to checking everything on their phones have difficulty reading paper maps.

arrange.ko: 아이들이 자기 속도대로 자라게 두는 부모는 아이들이 도전을 즐기는 자신감 있는 학습자가 되도록 돕는다.
arrange.bogi: parents who / helps them / let their children grow at their own pace / become confident learners who enjoy challenges
arrange.ans: Parents who let their children grow at their own pace help them become confident learners who enjoy challenges.

arrange.ko: 대출 기간이 길면 길수록, 돈을 빌려준 사람은 그 돈을 쓰기 전에 더 오래 기다려야 한다.
arrange.bogi: the longer the lender / before spending the money / the longer / have to wait / the term of a loan is
arrange.ans: The longer the term of a loan is, the longer the lender has to wait before spending the money.

arrange.ko: 문어 뉴런의 절반 이상이 중앙의 뇌가 아니라 다리에 있다는 사실은 많은 과학자들을 놀라게 했다.
arrange.bogi: is located in its arms / the fact that / have surprised many scientists / rather than its central brain / more than half of an octopus’s neurons
arrange.ans: The fact that more than half of an octopus’s neurons are located in its arms rather than its central brain has surprised many scientists.

arrange.ko: 늘 다른 사람의 지시를 따르는 데 익숙한 아이들은 자라면서 방향 감각을 잃는 경향이 있다.
arrange.bogi: tends to lose / children who / follow others’ instructions / their sense of direction as they grow up / are always used to
arrange.ans: Children who are always used to following others’ instructions tend to lose their sense of direction as they grow up.

translate.en: What makes this system unusual is where many of those neurons are located.
translate.ko: 이 체계를 특이하게 만드는 것은 그 뉴런들 중 다수가 어디에 위치해 있는가이다.

translate.en: Such children quickly lose their sense of direction as they grow, because they are used to being arranged for, rather than actively choosing their path.
translate.ko: 그러한 아이들은 자라면서 방향 감각을 빠르게 잃는데, 능동적으로 자신의 길을 선택하기보다는 남이 정해 주는 것에 익숙하기 때문이다.

translate.en: Consistent though he may be, some of Aristotle’s ideas meet us today as strange.
translate.ko: 비록 그가 일관적일지라도, 아리스토텔레스의 생각 중 일부는 오늘날 우리에게 낯설게 다가온다.

translate.en: Social and environmental responsibility has become an increasingly important ethical consideration for content creators.
translate.ko: 사회적, 환경적 책임은 콘텐츠 제작자들에게 점점 더 중요한 윤리적 고려 사항이 되어 왔다.

translate.en: As global awareness of social, environmental, and sustainability issues grows, many content creators are being called upon to consider the broader impact of their work.
translate.ko: 사회, 환경, 지속 가능성 문제에 대한 전 세계적 인식이 커짐에 따라, 많은 콘텐츠 제작자들은 자기 작업의 더 폭넓은 영향을 고려하도록 요구받고 있다.

translate.en: This includes addressing topics such as climate change, social justice, and ethical consumerism in their content.
translate.ko: 이것은 자신의 콘텐츠에서 기후 변화, 사회 정의, 윤리적 소비주의와 같은 주제를 다루는 것을 포함한다.

translate.en: Content creators have a platform that can influence their audience’s attitudes and behaviors, and they have a responsibility to use that platform for positive change.
translate.ko: 콘텐츠 제작자들은 청중의 태도와 행동에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 플랫폼을 가지고 있으며, 그 플랫폼을 긍정적인 변화를 위해 사용할 책임이 있다.

translate.en: For example, promoting environmentally sustainable products or supporting causes related to equality and justice can help raise awareness and drive meaningful social impact.
translate.ko: 예를 들어, 환경적으로 지속 가능한 제품을 홍보하거나 평등과 정의에 관련된 대의를 지지하는 것은 인식을 높이고 의미 있는 사회적 영향을 이끌어 내는 데 도움이 될 수 있다.

translate.en: Ethical content creators not only focus on promoting their products or services but also consider the values and causes they support, ensuring that their content aligns with their social and environmental principles.
translate.ko: 윤리적인 콘텐츠 제작자들은 자신의 제품이나 서비스를 홍보하는 데만 초점을 맞추는 것이 아니라 자신이 지지하는 가치와 대의도 고려하여, 자신의 콘텐츠가 자신의 사회적 · 환경적 원칙과 반드시 일치하도록 한다.

translate.en: He had no difficulty justifying slavery, for example, and in his era, philosophers enjoyed positions of high privilege and influence.
translate.ko: 예를 들어 그는 노예 제도를 정당화하는 데 아무런 어려움이 없었고, 그의 시대에 철학자들은 높은 특권과 영향력을 지닌 지위를 누렸다.
